messages:
Anita: Quick heads-up — Rina Patel submitted her resignation today, last day 2026-04-15. I want a staggered deprovision plan because she’s on an EMEA contractor visa and still owns a few project service accounts.
Sam-IT: Thanks Anita. Can you confirm laptop return window and whether we should do remote wipe or physical pickup?
Anita: Prefer physical pickup on 4/15 afternoon; she’s remote in Berlin. Payroll confirmed final paycheck + prorated bonus by 4/20.
Evan (Manager): I’ll schedule a 4/14 knowledge-transfer session for the team and drop the agenda. Please don’t cut SSO until 4/16 09:00 UTC so she can finish KT.
Liam-Sec: Agreed on delayed SSO. We should also stagger service tokens revocation: API keys, CI deploy keys, and monitoring write keys in that order. I can run a scoped sweep script.
Anita: Also benefits note — Rina is on the EU plan (not COBRA). She needs the local benefits termination form; payroll already queued the vendor notice. I told her to expect vendor outreach within 5 business days.
Sam-IT: Filing the access playbook now. Plan:
```
- 2026-04-15 17:00 CET: Laptop collected and signed off (IT ticket closes)
- 2026-04-16 09:00 UTC: SSO disable (SSO group removal)
- 2026-04-16 09:05 UTC: Revoke API keys and CI deploy tokens
- 2026-04-16 09:15 UTC: Remove from on-call rotations and PagerDuty groups
- 2026-04-16 09:30 UTC: Revoke write access to monitoring/alerts
```
Sam-IT: I added the script link: https://intranet/redwood/offboard-scripts (use runbook v3).
Liam-Sec: I'll run the shots and post the revocation log here when done. Evan, please make sure any shared docs are transferred to a team owner before SSO cut.
Evan (Manager): Yep, transferring ownership today. Quick Q on external contractor accounts — should we rotate any downstream service passwords now or after SSO cut?
Liam-Sec: Rotate after SSO cut to avoid accidental lockouts during KT, but schedule rotation window 1 hour after SSO disable. I'll annotate the playbook.
Anita: Exit interview scheduled for 4/10 14:00 CET (reminder to send opt-in/opt-out benefits summary beforehand). Also flagged final expense submission cutoff 4/16 EOD.
AccessBot: Reminder: offboard workflow created for user rina.p — ticket #OPS-7889. First assignee: Sam-IT.
Sam-IT: I've created a pickup slot with the courier for 4/15 14:00 CET (Berlin). Courier requires signed confirmation; I'll add the pickup form to the ticket.
Liam-Sec: Note for compliance — export controls on repo X. Evan, please ensure any restricted datasets are removed from her workspaces before 4/15.
Evan (Manager): On it. I'll run through the repo cleanup checklist and ping once done.
Anita: Thanks all. If nobody objects, we'll proceed with the staggered timeline above. Please post updates in this thread as tasks complete. :thumbsup:
